summary: Comprehensive CraftBolt.cz platform testing - Iteration 33. Backend: 35/36 tests passed (97%). Frontend: All major flows tested successfully. The Czech service marketplace platform is functioning well with minor issues noted.

minor.issue: Returns 403 instead of 401 for missing token - both are valid rejection codes but inconsistent with standard REST conventions

issues: Promoted suppliers section data-testid not found - may need to add for testing
SMS notification toggle selector not easily identifiable via data-testid

critical_code_review_comments: BulkGate SMS credentials (BULKGATE_APP_ID and BULKGATE_APP_TOKEN) are empty - SMS notifications will not work until configured
JWT HMAC key is 25 bytes (below recommended 32 bytes for SHA256) - security warning in logs
React useEffect dependency warnings in multiple components (CustomerDashboard, SupplierDashboard, DemandDetail, ProfilePage, RegisterPage) - not critical but should be addressed
seed_data_creation: Created test demands via API during testing (prefixed with TEST_)

BulkGate SMS is NOT configured (credentials empty). Stripe is in test mode.
